text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Still in Love didn't look well, so I 
brought her to the nurse's office.
choice_data_list:
Don't push yourself—just take it easy and 
get some rest.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Trainer... Yes, I apologize for causing 
you trouble...

text_block_list.name: Vampire Hunter
text_block_list.text: —I've cornered you, vampire princess!

text_block_list.name: Vampire Hunter
text_block_list.text:
Vile "Vampire Princess" who drinks blood 
and multiplies her kin! I shall strike you 
down with this sword of holy silver!

text_block_list.name: "Vampire Princess" Still
text_block_list.text:
N-No way... It's a misunderstanding, 
Hunter.

text_block_list.name: "Vampire Princess" Still
text_block_list.text:
"I am merely... living holding my breath, 
in this castle of shadows..."

text_block_list.name: "Vampire Princess" Still
text_block_list.text:
Humans, vampires... I don't want to hurt 
anyone...!

text_block_list.name: Vampire Hunter
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, as if I could ever trust a vampire's 
words! Prepare yourself!

text_block_list.name: "Vampire Princess" Still
text_block_list.text:
(...Ah, how did it come to this...? All I 
wanted was to live a quiet life.)

text_block_list.name: "Vampire Princess" Still
text_block_list.text:
(Together with that person... somewhere 
far away—)
—Are you hurt anywhere, Princess Still?!

text_block_list.name: "Vampire Princess" Still
text_block_list.text: ...Eh...? That voice is—!

text_block_list.name: Vampire Hunter
text_block_list.text: Wh... W-Who the heck are you?!

text_block_list.name: "Knight" Trai-ner
text_block_list.text:
My name is Trai-ner... Princess Still's 
eternal knight!

text_block_list.name: "Vampire Princess" Still
text_block_list.text: ...! Lord Trai-ner...!

text_block_list.name: "Knight" Trai-ner
text_block_list.text: Haaah—!

text_block_list.name: Vampire Hunter
text_block_list.text: Gwaah...! No way, in an instant...?!

text_block_list.name: "Knight" Trai-ner
text_block_list.text:
—I merely knocked them unconscious. Rest 
assured, Princess Still.

text_block_list.name: "Knight" Trai-ner
text_block_list.text:
Now, take my hand... Let us flee far away 
together.

text_block_list.name: "Vampire Princess" Still
text_block_list.text:
...I have been waiting for this moment for 
so long.

text_block_list.name: "Vampire Princess" Still
text_block_list.text:
"To a place where nobody knows us. Just 
the two of us, forever—"

text_block_list.name: "Vampire Princess" Still
text_block_list.text:
Forever and always... let us stay close by 
each other's side.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: "...Ah... Could that have just been—"

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"N-No way...! What is wrong with me, 
having such an embarrassing dream...?!"

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...Still... it was a good dream...
